scripts.build: npm install --prefix ../Frontend && npm run build --prefix ../Frontend && node -e "const fs=require('fs'); if (!fs.existsSync('dist')) fs.mkdirSync('dist'); if (fs.existsSync('../Frontend/.output/public')) fs.cpSync('../Frontend/.output/public', 'dist', {recursive: true}); if (fs.existsSync('../Frontend/dist')) fs.cpSync('../Frontend/dist', 'dist', {recursive: true});"
